# Open Access Directory

> A comprehensive, community-maintained wiki directory of open access resources, organizations, and educational materials hosted by Simmons University.

The Open Access Directory (OAD) is a collaborative reference resource built on MediaWiki that aggregates information about open access initiatives, advocacy organizations, repositories, and scholarly communication tools. Maintained by the Simmons School of Library and Information Science, it serves as a central hub for OA practitioners, researchers, and advocates seeking curated lists and directories.

## Getting Started

- [Open Access Directory](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Main_Page): Homepage for Open Access Directory wiki at Simmons University
- [Getting started as an OAD contributor](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Getting_started_as_an_OAD_contributor): Contributor guide for editing and contributing to OAD wiki
- [Request account](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Special:RequestAccount): Account registration and signup form for OAD wiki contributors
- [FAQs](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/FAQs): Frequently asked questions about OAD account creation and editing

## OA Resources & Directories

- [Advocacy organizations for OA](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Advocacy_organizations_for_OA): Directory listing of global OA advocacy organizations and initiatives
- [Data repositories](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Data_repositories): Directory of open data repositories and research data sharing platforms
- [Courses about OA](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Courses_about_OA): Directory of courses and educational resources on open access topics
- [Author addenda](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Author_addenda): Resource directory for author addenda and publication agreement templates
- [Declarations in support of OA](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Declarations_in_support_of_OA): Chronological listing of OA declarations, principles, and policy statements
- [Blogs about OA](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Blogs_about_OA): Directory of open access blogs and scholarly communication resources
- [Audio about OA](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Audio_about_OA): Curated directory of audio recordings and multimedia OA content

## Reference & Navigation

- [Categories](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Special:Categories): MediaWiki category listing and directory index for OAD resources
- [Acronyms](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Acronyms): Glossary of open access terminology and acronyms reference
- [Proposed lists](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Proposed_lists): Directory of proposed OA resource lists and editorial policies

## Support & Contact

- [Contact OAD](https://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Contact_OAD): Contact information for OAD Editorial Board and Simmons GSLIS
